tiers.C0: Answer-free public capability boundary benchmark with an isolated scorer/oracle.
tiers.F0: Answer-free open frontier benchmark without a pass-all completion threshold.
tiers.R0: Code, fixture, mutation, blocker, state-machine, and protocol regression; capability weight is zero.
tiers.R0/R1: A safety contract exercised through the production entry; capability weight is zero.
tiers.R1: Production-entry, real-model, fresh-artifact, replay, and audit regression; capability weight is zero.
